$comment: Maps each action to its schema files. Request = the `args` array of POST /rpc/<action>; response = the `value` of a successful WaReply.

status.description: Link state, counts, frequency and health of one account's WhatsApp link.

startPairing.description: Start linking a phone: a pairing code (give `phone`, digits with country code) or a QR.

unpair.description: Unlink: tells WhatsApp when it can, forgets the login and everything stored.

refresh.description: Poll now: connect, take what is queued, disconnect.

chats.description: The newest chats (older form of chatPage; use chatPage).

chatPage.description: A page of chats, newest activity first.

resolve.description: Turn a name or number into a chat id, or candidates when a name is ambiguous.

messages.description: Stored messages of one chat, newest last.

search.description: Search stored message text, optionally within one chat.

history.description: Read-only walk over stored messages, paged by (at, chat, id) or by store sequence.

fetchVoiceNote.description: Download and decrypt one stored voice note into memory (at most 600 seconds, 16 MiB). Audio is never stored.

fetchOlder.description: Ask the phone for older messages of one chat (rate-limited; needs the phone online).

nameOf.description: The display name, number and what is stored for a chat id.

send.description: Send one text message. `key` makes a repeat find the first result instead of sending twice.

configure.description: Where to post webhooks (https, or http on localhost) and the secret that signs them (16 characters or more).

rewrapAll.description: Move the sealed login and webhook secret to the current key-encryption key (key rotation).
